We have a soft target to kick off the PO on Oct 15. Any chance you can send the matrix and a short evidence index by COB Oct 10?

Thanks — short answers below.

1) For >2x capacity uplifts we do require a short-form SOW as an attachment at time of PO submission. The full SOW can follow within the 7-day handback window, but the short-form must accompany the PO to trigger the AR/OPs flow.
2) Yes — "SOC2-evidence-index.pdf" is the correct filename and will satisfy the auditors for the intake step.

I have updated the portal draft (request 5487) to include the short-form SOW placeholder and attached the SOC2-evidence-index.pdf so your procurement queue will pass automated validation. You should now be able to submit on your side.

If you submit before 10:00 PT we can process the PO the same day; otherwise it will be handled first thing the next business day.
